**isLikelyScreenshot:** false

**Scene/Setting:** Flat-lay style graphic card — a promotional menu tile with a cream/off-white rounded rectangle on a light grey background. No photographic elements; entirely typographic/illustrative design.

**Brand/Logo Cues:** "MIRA CAFE" (bold sans-serif, top of card, underlined by a thin rule). A small minimalist brown icon in the lower-right corner depicts a stylised cup/coffee figure (circle atop a horizontal bar).

**textVerbatim:**
> MIRA CAFE
> ЗАВТРАК
> РАФ 320
> КРУАССАН 260
> СКИДКА 15%
> 12 ИЮНЯ

**Observable details:** Dark green/near-black sans-serif typography throughout. The card lists two menu items with prices (РАФ 320, КРУАССАН 260), a 15% discount, and a date (12 ИЮНЯ / 12 June). Layout is clean, minimal, consistent with a branded café promotional graphic. Caption reads "Любимое место для завтрака" (provided as caption context).
